title: Explore/Logs Drilldown shared-settings vs Dashboard panel-option persistence must stay disconnected
answers: Enabling hover overflow in a dashboard panel also changed behavior in Explore, is that expected?
Should dashboard panel options and Explore local storage settings for logs table be linked?
Why doesn't toggling a logstable control in Explore affect dashboards or vice versa?
body:
Invariant: a logs table display setting exposed as a Dashboard panel option (persisted into the dashboard JSON) must not be wired to the same local-storage key used for the equivalent sidebar/control setting in Explore and Logs Drilldown; the two surfaces intentionally don't share state. Enforced conceptually in public/app/plugins/panel/logstable/module.tsx (hoverOverflow panel option) vs. Explore/Logs Drilldown local-storage-backed controls — if someone connects them, changing a setting on one dashboard panel would unexpectedly change behavior for every user viewing Explore/Logs Drilldown (and vice versa).
Fix pattern: keep per-surface state independent — panel options for dashboards, local storage keys for Explore/Logs Drilldown — even if the underlying feature (e.g. hover-to-expand overflowing cells) is the same.
Constraints: applies to any shared logstable/Logs UI behavior exposed differently to Dashboards vs Explore/Logs Drilldown; not relevant for settings only ever exposed in one surface.
applies: Grafana logstable panel and its counterparts in Explore / Logs Drilldown
says: Toggling hover overflow in a dashboard panel unexpectedly changes Explore logs display
